def _setup_logger() -> None:
    global _default_handler
    _root_logger.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
    if _default_handler is None:
        _default_handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
        _default_handler.flush = sys.stdout.flush
        _default_handler.setLevel(logging.INFO)
        _root_logger.addHandler(_default_handler)

    fmt = NewLineFormatter(
        _FORMAT,
        datefmt=_DATE_FORMAT,
        use_color=sys.stdout.isatty(),
    )
    _default_handler.setFormatter(fmt)
    _root_logger.propagate = False

mechanisms.content: environ.py: EnvVar is a descriptor with __set_name__ registering into _descriptors; __get__ caches into owner.__dict__ so first read wins; exceptions wrapped as type(e)(f'{self.name}: {e}'). Factory methods build config items; rearm(name)/rearm_all() reset cache. New config should be a factory method parsing int and requiring >=32. logger.py: _setup_logger creates _default_handler once (StreamHandler stdout, INFO) and sets a NewLineFormatter(_FORMAT, datefmt, use_color=isatty()). NewLineFormatter.__init__(fmt,datefmt,high_precision,use_color) stores flags; format() calls super().format(record) then aligns multiline using record.message, then colors. init_logger(name) sets DEBUG, propagate True under deepinfer prefix else attaches _default_handler. stats_logger.py: logger=init_logger(__name__); _log_worker(q) iterates iter(q.get,None), optional sleep by rank, for m in msgs: logger.info(m), need_sleep=q.empty(), except traceback.print_exc(). _emit_logs puts msgs on _log_queue. Only change: logger.info(m, extra={'keep_full_message': True}).
